# oralakeview

> Hotel offering Alpine lake and mountain views in Switzerland for travelers seeking a scenic stay.

## Main

- [ORA Lakeview Hotel | Scenic Swiss Alps & Lake View Stay](https://oralakeview.com/): Wake up to breathtaking lake and mountain views at ORA Lakeview Hotel in Switzerland. Just minutes from transit, pet-friendly, and with free parking—your effortless alpine escape
